messages.author: 024f2a916fa4b163
messages.subject: Multiple Instances of Shiny App
parts:
I'm trying to allow multiple users to use my shiny apps at the same time. My first thought was to assign each user a unique port to run on. 

I have found the multiple-ports appendix in the Admin Guide less then useful: 
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#run-shiny-server-on-multiple-ports

As it appears as though I do not have the multiple-ports.config file. 

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Multiple Instances of Shiny App
parts:
Hi,

The file is called: multi-server.config
But since this is a newer file that was added very recently, your version of Shiny Server might not have it.
Are you using Shiny Server open source or Pro? And what version?

The open source version of this file is here. 

Let us know if you ran into any issues using this configuration.

Fereshteh
